name: build_site_sign
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. A very readable wooden construction signpost driven into the soil. One thick crooked stake, broad rectangular rough plank, one painted cream hammer emblem. Bottom stake point and small attached dirt clod visibly touch the ground. Tall simple silhouette, plank takes upper half. No floating objects.
review: accepted: wood stake touches soil, large hammer silhouette, no lettering; non-pixel painted transparent static bitmap
